en:
There is a way to disable the alarm system.
An <CLT=cltSTRONG>Electrobomb<CLT=cltNORMAL> would take it down.

But Maki only had one bomb, and she used
it during the raid this morning...

Then the only other person who
could've used one is Kokichi, right?
Huuuh? Why would I use an Electrobomb?

I had no reason to shut off the alarm, right?
I'd be at a disadvantage if I did that.

I guess so... I can't come up with a reason
why Kokichi would wanna cut the alarm.

<CLT=cltMIND>But we know that the alarm system
was neutralized. It had to be.
<CLT=cltMIND>In that case, then...

I've got it! Disabling the alarm system
wasn't the real objective!
What?

<CLT=cltMIND>The main objective of Kokichi
using an Electrobomb was...
Disable the remote control

Perhaps Kokichi was trying
to knock out the remote control.

If that's why, then only Kokichi would've
been at a disadvantage, right?

We were being very cautious of the
Exisals...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Keep Keebo away

Maybe it has something to do with Keebo?
I remember that the Electrobomb hurt him...

The Electrobomb may have been the reason
I wasn't feeling well...

But that wasn't because I'm a robot!
I had an allergic reaction, you see!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Disable the press's safety function

Do you think the Electrobomb disabled
an electronic device inside the hangar...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The main objective of Kokichi
using an Electrobomb was...

It was to deactivate the safety
function on the press!
Deactivate...the safety function?

The Electrobomb wouldn't have just taken
down the alarm system...

...it also would have disabled the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>hydraulic press's safety function<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
That's true, but...why would he do that?

There's only one reason that
anyone would want to do that...

But if I'm right, it means that we've
been thinking about this all wrong!
All wrong...?

<CLT=cltMIND>What aspect of this case runs
contrary to the new evidence?
The mastermind of the killing game
Maybe Kokichi isn't the mastermind...
Nyeh? Why would that change?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Kaito's cause of death
The credibility of the death video

Maybe the bomb affected
the death video somehow.

The bomb interferes with communication...
I don't think it affected the video camera...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

The safety function on the hydraulic press
is meant to detect living organisms...
Maybe that was neutralized somehow?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>What piece of evidence is called into
question if the safety function was off?
...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaito's cause of death<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...What?

If the Electrobomb was used while Maki
was trying to deliver the antidote...

Maybe Kaito didn't die by poison.
It could be something else entirely.

<CLT=cltMIND>Yes, the cause of
death could now be...
Such as...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Is that a cause of death that we should
consider in place of the poisoned arrow...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Other than the poisoned arrow, what
is the other potential cause of death?

The <CLT=cltSTRONG>hydraulic press<CLT=cltNORMAL>! Kaito could have
been killed by the press after all!
What!? He could've!?

If the safety was off, the press could have
crushed Kaito while he was still alive.

Right after I threw the antidote, I tried
to open the shutter...
So...Kaito should've still been alive!

And if he was crushed by the hydraulic press
after that, then we have our cause of death!

If that's the case, it'd mean the
one who killed Kaito wasn't Maki...

It would be whoever was operating the
hydraulic press...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kokichi<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

I see...very impressive. The hydraulic press
*could* have been the cause of death.
But that's...just a possibility.
What do you mean?

It's possible that I killed Kaito with
the press, but there's no way to know.

Kaito's death could have been either 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>poison arrow<CLT=cltNORMAL> or the <CLT=cltSTRONG>hydraulic press<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Both causes are possible, but you'll never
be able to determine it...
...no matter what.
No matter what?

Th-That's not true! We can probably
solve this mystery, too!
Right, Shuichi?

<CLT=cltMIND>Is it really possible to determine
Kaito's actual cause of death?
It is possible

<CLT=cltMIND>...No, there's no evidence that
determines the cause of death absolutely.

Huh? S-Shuichi?
It can't be...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't want to accept it either...
I don't want to believe it, but...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
It is not possible

W-What's wrong?
Say something!

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't want to accept it either...
I don't want to believe it, but...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>Was Kaito's cause of death the poisoned arrow or
the hydraulic press? Is it possible to tell?

I hate to admit it, but Kokichi is right.
We have no way to prove the cause of death.
Wh-What did you say!?

You can't check the body, and you don't
have any conclusive evidence...

You can't deduce any more from here on out.
There's no way to know what happened.
...But I know, cuz I was actually involved.
So that's what you were trying to do...
You were trying to commit an unsolvable murder!

Nee-heehee... Do you finally get it?
Yup, that was my plan.

The gimmick of this murder case isn't
the unknown victim...
But rather, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>unknowable culprit<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

No one understands but me!
Only *I* know the answer!

There's no more room for deduction here!
Choose the culprit with your own intuition!
I-Intuition?

Nee-heehee... Are you troubled?
I'm sure robots don't have intuition, right?

But there's nothing you can do about it.
This is just how the trial goes.
So...who is the culprit? Maki or me...?

The heart-racing excitement as the blackened
and the spotless face off! It's...VOTING TIME!!!

Hey! That's my line! I'm the one
who decides when it's Voting Time!

Aw, c'mon... No one's gonna figure out the
truth. Let's just vote already.

This won't be a problem, right, Monokuma?
Cuz you know who the culprit is, don't you?
...Just like you always do.
Y-Yes...of course...
Nyeh? What kind of a reaction is that?

Th-The culprit, you say?
Ah, y-yes... Of c-course I know...
Hm? Why do you seem so flustered?

F-Flustered? Me? Hahahaha!
What are you talking about?

<CLT=cltMIND>...What's going on with
Monokuma right now...?

Monokuma...do you not know who the culprit
is, either!?

Huh!? Whaddaya mean I don't know!?
Uh, what don't I know, huh!?
...You don't know, do you?

What does this mean!? Why doesn't 
Monokuma know who the culprit is!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma...doesn't know who
the culprit is either?

<CLT=cltMIND>If Monokuma doesn't know,
what does that tell us about this case...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Wait...<CLT=cltSTRONG>this case<CLT=cltMIND>?

Yes, that's it! So that's what Kokichi's
<CLT=cltSTRONG>real objective<CLT=cltNORMAL> was!
Huh? What are you talking about?

Kokichi wasn't just trying to commit a murder
that we couldn't figure out...

He was trying to <CLT=cltSTRONG>commit a murder that
Monokuma couldn't figure out<CLT=cltNORMAL>, either!
...A murder Monokuma couldn't figure out?

But what's the point of that? Kokichi's
the one who's controlling Monokuma!

But consider how many elements of this
case would be cleared up.

Prior to this case, Monokuma always knew
the specific details of each crime, correct?

That must mean that he was using
some way of monitoring us...

Perhaps there are hidden cameras, strategically
placed to avoid our detection...

I can't say for certain, but he must
be keeping watch somehow.

Kokichi probably used the Electrobomb
to scramble whatever that was.

The Electrobomb *would* prevent any cameras
from sending video wirelessly.

Which means, it wouldn't matter where the
surveillance cameras were hidden.

Like I said, what's the point!?
Kokichi's the one who's controlling Monokuma!

Before we determine that for sure,
I want to make one thing clear.

If the objective were to create a crime
that would stump Monokuma, the Exisals...

Yes...the Exisals weren't protecting
Monokuma, they were...
Attacking him
They were attacking him

No... When I saw the Exisals, they weren't
attacking.

Also, Monokuma and the Exisals are
both controlled by Kokichi!

So there's no way they'd attack
Monokuma!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Bullying him
Th-They were bullying Monokuma...

Bullying him...? That's not what it looked
like to me.

Also, Monokuma and the Exisals are
both controlled by Kokichi!

So there's no way they'd attack
Monokuma!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Watching him
Admiring him
<CLT=cltMIND>...There's no way that's it.

They had Monokuma surrounded...and if
they weren't protecting him, then...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

I assumed they were protecting him because
they didn't appear to be harming him, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The four Exisals in the courtyard
around Monokuma...
They were <CLT=cltSTRONG>watching<CLT=cltNORMAL> Monokuma.
Watching him!?

Yes. Remember what Monokuma said
earlier in the investigation?

Oh, at the time, the Exisals were on auto-pilot
and directed to only observe me.

If they were protecting him like bodyguards,
they wouldn't have been facing him.

They would have been scanning
the area, watching us.

But they weren't. That implies that they
weren't watching us, they were watching *him*.

They were trying to make sure that Monokuma
wouldn't go near the crime scene.

That reminds me... Before I stole an Exisal,
all four units were focused on Monokuma.

That's why when I stole one to enter the
hangar, the other three didn't pursue me.

So Monokuma must have been talking about
Maki...

Even if it puts someone at a disadvantage,
the class trial must always be fair.

The person who shared that info with me didn't
seem interested in sharing it with you guys...

So you share it instead! That way, it'll be
fair to all the participants!

She didn't want to share that information
because it would've linked her to the murder.
In which case...it could only be Maki.
...You're right.
Um, so...to summarize this discussion...

Kokichi used the Electrobomb in the hangar,
and the Exisals to watch Monokuma...

Thereby creating a <CLT=cltSTRONG>scenario in which
Monokuma has no idea who the culprit is<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

I told you there's no point! 
Kokichi's the one who's controlling Monokuma!

No, Kokichi might not be controlling Monokuma
at all!
Wh-What!?

But Kokichi's the mastermind, right!?
Shouldn't he be controlling Monoku—
Kokichi might not be the mastermind!
Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-Whaaat!?

Remember that the only reason we think
that, is because Kokichi told us.

Monokuma hasn't said a word about that.
It's possible that Kokichi is just lying to us.
Ah-hahahaha! No way I lied!

I'm definitely controlling Monokuma. The
<CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind of the killing game<CLT=cltNORMAL> is totally me.

The one who pitted humanity's last survivors
against each other is...all me, baby!

That's right! He's a Remnant of Despair!
How'd we forget that?

But that doesn't necessarily mean
that he's the mastermind.

Umm...well...I guess.
But is that really possible?
...Well, Monokuma?

I can't answer that without causing problems,
cuz I gotta run this trial fair and squa—
Even more reason to give us the answer!

If you don't tell us the truth right now,
you'll be an accomplice to Kokichi's lies.

Does that sound like a fair game?
Would you say this class trial is fair?

Yeah, tell us! Is Kokichi the
real mastermind or not!?

No need to think about it. You're being
way too forward, y'know?
Aren't you normally the forward one?
<CLT=cltMIND>...Ah!

I mean, I don't mind cuz that's probably
part of your strategy, too...

But, in the interest of fairness, I suppose it's
time to tell the truth.

Unlike the lies you love so much, the truth
should be impartial to everyone.
...And what *is* that truth?

I'm not being controlled by Kokichi.
Cuz he's not the mastermind.
Wh-Wh-Wh-WHA-WHA-WHA-WHAAAAAAAAAT!?
Is that...really true?

Kokichi was just messing with you. I never
once said he was the mastermind.
Then it was all Kokichi's lie!?
Yeah, that is what that would mean.

With the key from the last motive, he was the
first to learn the <CLT=cltSTRONG>truth of the outside world<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Based on his deductions, he fabricated a lie
to make you all think he was the mastermind.
I see. Kokichi's own deductions...

Do you wanna know?
Then I'll tell you.

I'm getting kinda bored with all the lying, so
everything I say now will be the truth, 'kay?

His deductions got a lot of details right,
though. Pretty impressive, honestly.
But, what about the Exisals!?

If Kokichi wasn't the mastermind, how'd
he control them so easily?
He just used <CLT=cltSTRONG>Miu's remote control<CLT=cltNORMAL>, right?
<CLT=cltMIND>Miu's remote control...?

So the remote that Kokichi was using
was made by Miu?
Oh, you didn't know?

Miu not only invented the Electrobomb
and the Electrohammer...

she also made a <CLT=cltSTRONG>remote control that can
hijack any electronic device<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Kokichi just slapped a receiver on each of
the Exisals and took them for a spin!

Hey, isn't it a bit unfair to tell them
all that?

Fairness has nothing to do with it.
I offered up that info purely out of spite.

Spite towards you, for trying to usurp the
mastermind's role and take over the game!

Well, whatever. It's way more interesting 
to defeat an enemy who plays dirty anyway.

Wh-What's going on? It seems like
they're...actually fighting...

There's no doubt about it.
Kokichi isn't the mastermind.

Were we just being dragged around
by Kokichi's lies the whole time!?

What were you trying to accomplish by 
pretending to be the mastermind, Kokichi?

Nyeh! Now you're gonna be all quiet!?
This is so frustrating!
Then if he's not the mastermind, who is!?

Why are you so certain there's even
a mastermind to begin with?
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?
What do you mean?

Why, that's on a need-to-know basis, and
you don't need to know.
But I wanna know!

<CLT=cltMIND>The <CLT=cltSTRONG>real mastermind<CLT=cltMIND> is not Kokichi...
Who could it be?

<CLT=cltMIND>I was thinking it was Junko Enoshima,
but that can't be it.

<CLT=cltMIND>She's dead. We've never come
into contact with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>If so...who's done this?
Who planned this killing game?

Anyway, this conversation has flown off the
rails. Let's get things back on track.

This class trial is to figure out who the
culprit is, not the mastermind.
So, yeah... Get to talkin'!

I agree. Before we worry about who the
mastermind is, or what my intent is...
Let's figure out the culprit!

But Monokuma doesn't know who it is. How
is he supposed to confirm the results?

We don't need to worry about that. Let's just
leave the decision-making to Monokuma.

But...you gotta run the class trial, too.
So no mistakes, okaaaay?
...Are you tryin' to get me to do something?

You've been watching us solve all these cases,
but you can't be a spectator anymore.

You're gonna participate in the class trial
from here on out.
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?

So, let's resume this class trial!
Monokuma, you gotta use your brain too!

This will be the final class trial!
Me versus Monokuma!
You versus Monokuma?
...When I play a game, I intend to win.

But what's considered winning in this game?
Beating the other players?

No...beating the game's mastermind is
the true victory.

And that's how I'll win! That's why I decided
to challenge Monokuma!

If I can deceive Monokuma till the very end, 
then I'll be the winner!

You're dragging us around like this...
just so you can win a game?

As I suspected... Your thought process
defies all logic.

But since the outside world is in total ruin,
this game is the only entertainment we have...

At least I can enjoy this game to the fullest
and feel good winning.

You really are a Remnant of Despair...
Your way of thinking is just chaotic.
...Remnant of Despair?
Eh, whatevs. Let's just get this started.

If the students or Monokuma don't know
who the culprit is, then I'm the winn—

Don't underestimate me.
Or Shuichi and the others for that matter.
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?

Puhuhu... It's just like a Remnant of Despair
to try to assume control of the game.

But these kids are all that's left
of Hope's Peak Academy.

If you think they're gonna make this easy
for you, you better think again!
Whose side are you taking he—
Side? Isn't it obvious!?
...Monokuma joins your party.
Nyeh!? Who invited you!?

Now, let's join forces and unravel the truth
behind this case!
Well, we were going to do it anyway...

Let's just ignore Monokuma. His actions are
always beyond comprehension.
Yeah! Let's just focus on the case!
Hey! Be quiet so we can ignore you!

Now, where should we start? We've already
established what Kokichi is after...
He's just gonna keep talking anyway, isn't he?

In my experience, whenever you learn
a new fact...
...you learn something else along with it.
Yes, let's look for that!

You warmed up to him real fast...
I guess you *are* both robots.

<CLT=cltMIND>So, another truth comes out...
<CLT=cltSTRONG>That piece of evidence<CLT=cltMIND> makes more sense now.

<CLT=cltMIND><CLT=cltSTRONG>The evidence<CLT=cltMIND> that I
couldn't wrap my head around.

If Kokichi planned that from the start...then
that first piece of evidence is suspicious, no?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

I already know about that. We need
evidence of what I don't know about.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

If Monokuma doesn't know who the culprit is,
what evidence needs to be analyzed again?

Let's discuss the video of Kaito being
crushed by the hydraulic press.

Kokichi said that he filmed that video to
prove he was not the victim.

But we know that Kokichi was trying to
mislead Monokuma, so what about the video?

It's pretty strange to present evidence
that condemns you, after all.

Then what kinda mistake was Kokichi tryin'
to get me to make?

Maybe he crushed Kaito with the hydraulic
press so the cause of death would be unknown?

But if that were the only objective,
there would be no need to film it.

Discovering the crushed body would have
been enough. No need to show us the film.
That's true.

I guess you're starting to fit in after all.
If you get any cuter, I'm gonna hug you!
Huh? Really?

There must be a reason you went out of
your way to show us the body being crushed.

No reason, really.
That's just my twisted personality.

<CLT=cltMIND>You're lying again, Kokichi.
There's a method to your madness.

<CLT=cltMIND>If you wanted Monokuma to make a
mistake, then showing us the video...

<CLT=cltMIND>it must have something to do with
trying to fool Monokuma.

<CLT=cltMIND>Taking the video of the murder but keeping
the victim's identity hidden...

<CLT=cltMIND>What does it show?
What doesn't it show?
